Name: CreateDungeonEnterWindow
Purpose: Allocates cDungeonEnter, binds DungeonEnter UI name and dispatches first virtual Build/Init call.

Name: BuildDungeonEnterRoot
Purpose: Creates root background, close button, Enter button, then builds list/reward/participation/preview panels.

Name: BuildDungeonListPanel
Purpose: Creates left dungeon list frame, title text, scroll/list component and selected-list stroke.

Name: BuildDungeonListButton
Purpose: Creates each dungeon row thumbnail/button and list difficulty marker.

Name: BuildRewardPanel
Purpose: Creates monster reward frame and title.

Name: BuildParticipationPanel
Purpose: Creates participation condition frame and user/capacity icon.

Name: BuildRequirementTabs
Purpose: Creates requirement section titles for clear/entry/item info.

Name: RenderRequirementRow
Purpose: Formats quest, tamer level, and digimon level requirement rows.

Name: BuildDungeonPreviewPanel
Purpose: Creates main image frame, name frame, difficulty badge and reward info button.

Name: BuildClearRewardListButton
Purpose: Creates clear reward list button component.

Name: LoadDungeonTables
Purpose: Registers/loads DungeonList, Qualification, Obtainable, Value, Reward, StepInfo, ClearInfo and Old bins.

Name: LoadMapDungeonRegionTables
Purpose: Registers/loads MapDungeonRegion bin used by dungeon region lookup.
